content.description: Project Frostpeak is an immersive tactical role-playing game set in the frozen ruins of the Northern kingdom of Frostpeak. The player assumes the role of a legendary pathfinder aiding the Frostpeak Resistance in reclaiming their home and restoring the lineage of King Arven from the occupying forces of the Cinder Vanguard.

visual_notes: High-contrast color palette pairing warm oranges and elemental reds from Cinder Vanguard fire engines against deep icy blues and granite grays of frozen Northern citadel ruins.
Characters have sharp, hand-painted textures highlighting the gritty, cold environment.

content.lore_background: Project Frostpeak is set in the frozen ruins of the Northern kingdom of Frostpeak, centering around the aftermath of the Ember Siege of 842 where the volcanic nation of Vulcana, led by Warlord Ignis, launched an elemental assault to seize control of Frostpeak's geothermal energy and rich sky-iron deposits.

levels.focus: Players navigate a vertical cliffside path interspersed with active volcanic vents, sky-iron ore veins, and steam checkpoints. The level culminates at the monumental East Gate, which remains barricaded by Cinder Vanguard defenses.
